description: Fork of exp428 (1.498) testing a TIED LUT unembedder (no Linear head). Changes: (1) dual stream collapses to E=64 (residual_dim=64); residual_lut decodes R^E; the summed residual stream IS the predicted token embedding. (2) Unembedder = RowTokenLUTUnembedder: tph=16 hash tables, NAP=15 (2^15=V), row r = token r, learned per-(table,row) scalar vote weight (0.52M params, matmul-free, vs the 12.58M Linear head). Inputs L2-normalised so hash/bit-margins are scale-consistent and the embedder<->unembedder tie naturally. (3) Two losses, both with the winner-take-all ASSIGNMENT STE (validated necessary in tied_lut_inverse_test.py: naive STE -> 2% top1, assignment -> 99.94%): MAIN = CE(unemb(pred_emb), next) + main_bit (route pred_emb to closest table, push its bits to the next-token pattern); AUX = CE(unemb(emb_table_subsample), ids) + aux_bit (make each token embedding self-invertible). Report main bpb + aux CE. tok_emb init 0.5; tok_emb_lr/unemb_lr raised so the hash assignment can organise.
